changes.title: Azure Botanica (RTW)
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Colour: Deep Blue with cool green sequins, accented with silver, champagne gold and soft blush.

Azure Botanica pairs a long silk shirt in deep petrol blue with a sweeping velvet skirt. Oversized blooms and trailing leaves extend across the front, back and sheer sleeves, with silver, champagne-gold and soft blush accents woven through the design. Pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads bring dimension to the embroidery, while dense embellishment frames the V-neckline, cuffs and daman.

The matching silk dupatta carries scattered floral motifs and a richly embroidered border, embellished with pearls, sequins and cut-glass beads. Delicate beaded drops finish the pallu, and a fine silver trim traces the hem of the flared velvet skirt.

Details:
Model size Small
